topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't even begin to tell you how much I wish we were in a better place right now. Your idea, you put so much into it, and to find out someone beat you to the patent... it feels like all that hard work, all those late nights, and all those moments of inspiration just kind of... fade away. But listen, this isn't the end. It might not seem like it now, but every setback is just a setup for a comeback. We've got to keep pushing, keep dreaming, and maybe the next big thing you come up with won't just be a step forward, but a leap. You've got this, and I'm right here, ready to cheer you on.
